requirement: v3.7.3 UI requirement: the GPW operations panel is not pinned to the left sidebar by default, even when the GPW subplugin is enabled; the operator must explicitly pin it, and unpinning removes the row again.
notes: The DSH host starts every registered sidebar.panellist row pinned (createPanelPins initialises unpinned to NO_PANELS) and exposes no plugin API for 'default unpinned'. v3.7.3 therefore does not register the GPW sidebar row until the operator presses 「固定到左侧边栏」 in the GPW panel; the composer launcher and main page remain available meanwhile. The row is registered dynamically and the preference is stored in localStorage; neither path changes permissions or approval behaviour. Verified by the browser-less client bundle tests and the client budget test on the ToFuture Windows host.
